title: Sunday · the blank two-thirds
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (A Third of a Page · deepening)
logline: The last of the run's Sundays the book keeps: the strip's third, and the other two-thirds left as the paper's blank — no ads drawn this time, just the newsprint, and in its middle, tiny, the scruff mark alone.

panels.composition: Tier 1 (a third): the bay from the bluff, cramped, the ridge and the glow squeezed into a band.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, a very shallow tier of a bay from a bluff with a ridge and a faint warm glow squeezed into a narrow band, no words

panels.name: Band

panels.composition: Tier 2: blank newsprint. Nothing drawn. The paper's gray.

image.prompt: a blank area of gray newsprint texture with nothing drawn on it, no words
image.notes: Leave it blank. Newsprint texture only.

panels.name: Blank

panels.composition: Tier 3: blank. And in its center, tiny: the scruff, asleep, alone in the space the strip used to have.

image.prompt: a blank gray newsprint area with one tiny ink mark of a small sleeping scruff of a dog at its exact center, no words
image.notes: The margin mark moved into the page. The only time.

panels.name: The scruff

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Two-thirds blank. The scruff in the middle of the space.
